sections.title: Overview
sections.body: # gunnchOS Stochastic & DSP Lab > This repo is part of the **gunnchOS wireless engineering spine**: hands-on labs that strengthen the technical foundation behind 7GC, AI-RAN, RF, DSP, MIMO, measurement, and **6G PhD readiness** for target wireless communications engineering programs. Not affiliated with any university.

sections.title: What this is
sections.body: Research and teaching lab for **target wireless communications engineering programs**-aligned skills — built as an independent portfolio project.

sections.title: Why wireless engineering readiness cares
sections.body: Core DSP and stochastic processes for wireless receivers and OFDM.

sections.body: make install && make test && make e2e
